en.name: Wind Operative
en.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they're nominated, the nominee dies. If 3 or less live, you lose this ability.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose a player: if they're nominated, the nominee dies. If 3 or less live, you lose this ability.

en.firstNightReminder: Wake up the Wind Operator. Let Wind Operator point a player. Place the "Marked" mark next to the player's character marker. During the day, if a player nominates the "marked" player, a "Dead" reminder mark will be placed next to the role mark of the player who initiated the nomination.
